## Design changes made in this session (inherited design found unsound or incomplete)
- Cover was held by 10 standoffs only: now a shear panel with 35 M3 screws round a closed loop at <= 40 mm (17 standoffs, 18 hard wall bosses with M3 inserts / tapped M3), tool-checked.
- Screw heads were not modelled; modelling them showed the M4 T-head screw heads overlapping the rear wall / EMI comb, the 6.5 hole breaking out of the spreader edge,
  a rear spreader screw head on a lid standoff, the vent and the thermal cut-out: T-head screws now M3 low-head at x 76.8, screws / cut-out relocated.
- EMI bond-pitch check counted clearance holes as bond points: now only clamping screws / standoffs (clamping tool-checked); standoffs on fence feet 10.5 mm.
- Added: light-trap chimney drains (tool-checked: open passage, no line of sight), heater NTC, 5 mm side-rail variant RR-HD-S-433/434, FRAME-isolation check,
  overhang (support) analysis of printed parts, transport-cover fit check (cover moved behind the x-stop shoulders / wing returns), M2.5 insert holes 3.7 (prototype) /
  tap drills (production), desiccant moved to the front strip, dummy resistor block off a board screw, print orientation fixes (dummy spacer, cable rest).
